subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should this PR's doctor migration be accepted as the upgrade path for shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` configs?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes a previously accepted config value and changes upgrade behavior for existing configs, which is compatibility-sensitive even though the prior runtime result was already no OTLP export.

options.title: Accept the doctor migration
options.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after the PR is refreshed against current main and exact-head checks are clean.

options.title: Keep grpc as a future config contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR and instead sponsor the larger real gRPC exporter implementation with dependency, runtime, docs, and tests.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after the PR is refreshed against current main and exact-head checks are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The original diagnostics exporter/config surface traces to `steipete`, making him the best available owner for accepting or redirecting the compatibility direction.
